verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is a hosted data service with managed embedding and reranking models, so a no-training guarantee or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never states that customer data is excluded from model training, nor does it document any training opt-out. Encryption at rest, customer-managed keys, BAAs, BYOC deployments and PrivateLink are adjacent privacy controls, not a training-use guarantee, so they earn no credit.
